governance.rule: No architectural change without checking the Constitution and Module Standard first.

router.role: central user event and navigation routing

state_management.rule: State-dependent modules receive messages only when their state is active.

governance_rules: Do not connect modules directly to index.js unless root lifecycle integration is required.
Do not place module business logic in router.js.
Every user-facing module must have an explicit entrypoint.
Every user-facing module must be registered through the Router.
Every visible command, button, callback or menu entry must have a registered route.
Old implementations must be removed after successful replacement.
Architectural exceptions must be documented before implementation.
